children.text: || iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe sarganirūpaṇaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 1 ||
taṃ taṃ vikāraṃ ca paraṃ pareśo
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe sṛṣṭiracanāprakāro nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 3 ||
sarge tu bhutāni dhiyaś ca khāni
|| iti śrinarasiṃhapurāṇe puṃsavanākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 6 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe mārkaṇḍeyamṛtyuṃjayo nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 7 ||
ke vā te yair hatā vayam
yamo hi vaktuṃ kṛtavān manaḥ svayam
bhṛgos tu pautreṇa ca yā purā kṛtā
sve sve hi rūpe svayam eva saṃsthitam
namo 'stu te devadeva mahācitta mahākāya mahāprājña mahādeva mahākīrte brahmendracandrarudrārcitapādayugala śrīpadmahasta saṃmarditadaityadeha ||

anantabhogaśayanārpitasarvāṅga sanakasanandanasanatkumārādyair yogibhir nāsāgranyastalocanair anavaratam abhicintitamokṣatattva |
gandharvavidyādharayakṣakiṃnarakiṃpuruṣair aharaho gīyamānadivyayaśaḥ ||
nṛsiṃha nārāyaṇa padmanābha govinda govardhanaguhānivāsa yogīśvara deveśvara jaleśvara maheśvara ||
yogadhara mahāmāyādhara vidyādhara yaśodhara kīrtidhara triguṇanivāsa tritattvadhara tretāgnidhara ||
lokanātha yajñeśvara yajñapriya tejomaya bhaktipriya vāsudeva duritāpahārārādhya puruṣottama namo 'stu te ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe mārkaṇḍeyacaritaṃ nāma ekādaśo 'dhyāya || NarP 11 ||
kim anyad adyaiva vadāmi śaṃsa me
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe yamīyamasaṃvādo nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāya || NarP 12 ||
chitvā ca viṣṇoḥ padam eti mānavaḥ
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe brahmacārisaṃvādo nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāya || NarP 13 ||
bhādhaṃ ca kṛtvā sa yatir babhūva
dhyātvā ca nityaṃ hṛdi śuddham ādyam
tat prāpya te yānti hareḥ padaṃ mahat
ity etad uktaṃ tava putra pṛcchataḥ
te yānti siddhiṃ paramāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe viṣṇoḥ stavarājanirūpaṇe ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāya || NarP 16 ||
nārāyaṇāya nama ity ayam eva satyaṃ
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe aṣṭākṣaramantramāhātmyaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāya || NarP 17 ||
ḥtasmai tvaṣṭā duhitaraṃ saṃjñāṃ nāma kanyāṃ dattavān ||

so 'pi tvāṣṭrīṃ rūpavatīṃ manojñāṃ prāpya tayā saha reme |
sā katipayāt kālāt svabhartur ādityasya tāpam asahantī pitur gṛhaṃ jagāma ||
tām avalokya sutāṃ pitovāca kiṃ putri tava bhartā savitā snehāt tvāṃ rakṣaty uta paruṣa iti ||

evaṃ pitur vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃjñā taṃ pratyuvāca |
dagdhāhaṃ bhartuḥ pracaṇḍatāpād iti ||
evaṃ śrutvā tām āha pitā gaccha putri bhartur gṛham iti ||

yuvatīstrīṇāṃ bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇam eva dharmaḥ śreyān |
aham api katipayadivasād āgatyādityasyoṣṇatāṃ jāmātur uddhariṣyāmi ||

ityuktā sā ca punar bhartur gṛhaṃ prāpya katipayadivasān manuṃ yamīṃ yamaṃ cāpatyatrayam ādityāt prāsūta |
punas taduṣṇatām asahantī chāyāṃ bhartur apabhogāya svaprajñābalenotpādya tatra saṃsthāpya gatvottarakurūn adhiṣṭhāyāśvī bhūtvā vicacāra ||
ādityo 'pi saṃjñeyam iti matvā tasyāṃ jāyāṃ punar apatyatrayam utpādayām_asa ||

manuṃ śanaiścaraṃ tapatīṃ ca |
sveṣv apatyeṣu pakṣapātena vartatīṃ chāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā yamaḥ svapitaram āha neyam asmanmāteti ||

pitāpi tac chrutvā bhāryāṃ prāha |
sarveṣv apatyeṣu samam eva vartatām iti ||

punar api sveṣv apatyeṣu snehāt pravartatīṃ chāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā yamo yamī ca tāṃ bahuvidham apīttham uvāca |
ādityasaṃnidhānāt tūṣṇīṃ babhūvataḥ ||

tataś chāyā tayoḥ śāpaṃ dattavatī |
yama tvaṃ pretarājo bhava yami tvaṃ yamunā nāma nadī bhavet ||
tataḥ krodhād ādityo 'pi chāyāputrayoḥ śāpaṃ dattavān he putra śanaiścara tvaṃ graho bhava krūradṛṣṭir mandagāmī ca pāpagrahas tvaṃ ca ||
putri tapatī nāma nadī bhaveti athādityo dhyānam āsthāya saṃjñā kva sthiteti vicārayām_asa ||

sa dṛṣṭavān uttarakuruṣu dhyānacakṣuṣāśvībhūya vicarantī |
svayaṃ cāśvarūpeṇa tatra gatvā tayā saha saṃparkaṃ kṛtavān ||

tasyām evādityād aśvināv utpannau tayor atiśayavapuṣoḥ sākṣāt prajāpatir āgatya devatvaṃ yajñabhāgatvaṃ mukhyaṃ ca devānāṃ bhiṣajatvaṃ dattvā jagāma |
ādityaś cāśvarūpaṃ vihāya svabhāryāṃ saṃjñāṃ tvāṣṭrīṃ svarūpadhāriṇīṃ nītvā svarūpam āsthāya divaṃ jagāma ||
viśvakarmā cāgatya ādityaṃ nāmabhiḥ stutvā tadatiśayoṣṇatāṃśatām apaśātayām_asa ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe aśvinor utpattir nāma aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāya || NarP 18 ||
putrāḥ parābhūtā ditiś ca vinaṣṭaputrā mahendradarpaharaṃ putram icchantī kaśyapam ṛṣiṃ svapatim ārādhayām_asa ||

sa ca tapasā saṃtuṣṭo garbhādhānaṃ cakāra tasyām |
punas tām evam uktavān ||

yadi tvaṃ śuciḥ satī śaracchatam imaṃ garbhaṃ dhārayiṣyasi tataś ca mahendradarpahantā putro bhaviṣyati |
ity evam uktā sā ca taṃ garbhaṃ dhārayām_asa ||

indro 'pi taj jñātvā vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇāgatya ditipārśvaṃ sthitavān |
kiṃcid ūnapūrṇe varṣaśate pādaśaucam akṛtvā ditiḥ śayanam āruhya nidrāṃ gatā ||

so 'pi labdhāvasaro vajrapāṇis tatkukṣiṃ praviśya vajreṇa taṃ garbhaṃ saptadhā ciccheda |
so 'pi tena pracchidyamāno ruroda ||
mā rodīr iti vadann indras tān saptadhaikaikaṃ ciccheda ||

saptadhā te sarve maruto yato jātamātrān mā rodīr ity uktavān |
mahendrasya sahāyā amī maruto nāma devā babhūvuḥ ||
śṛṇvaṃś ca bhaktyā harilokam eti saḥ

ādau tāvad brahmā brahmaṇo marīciḥ |
marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ kaśyapād ādityaḥ ||
ḥvikukṣer dyotaḥ dyotād veno venāt pṛthuḥ pṛthoḥ pṛthāśvaḥ ||
māndhātuḥ purukutsaḥ purukutsād dṛṣado dṛṣadād abhiśaṃbhuḥ ||

hārītād rohitāśvo rohitāśvād aṃśumān |
aṃśumato bhagīrathaḥ ||
śatruṃdamād anaraṇyaḥ anaraṇyād dīrghabāhuḥ dīrghabāhor ajaḥ ||

ajād daśarathaḥ |
daśarathād rāmaḥ rāmāl lavaḥ lavāt padmaḥ ||

sūryavaṃśabhavās te prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ /*
yair iyaṃ pṛthivī bhuktā dharmataḥ kṣatriyaiḥ purā //

ādau tāvad brahmā |
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro marīcir marīcer dākṣāyaṇyāṃ dākṣāyiṇyāṃ kaśyapaḥ ||

kaśyapād aditer ādityaḥ |
ādityāt suvarṇalāyāṃ manuḥ ||

nahuṣāt pitṛvatyāṃ yayātiḥ |
yayāteḥ śarmiṣṭhāyāṃ pūruḥ ||

bhojasya liṅgāyāṃ duṣyantaḥ |
duṣyantasya śakuntalāyāṃ bharataḥ ||

bharatasya nandāyām ajamīḍhaḥ |
ajamīḍhasya sudevyāṃ pṛśniḥ |
pṛśner ugrasenāyāṃ prasaraḥ |

pāṇḍoḥ kuntidevyām arjunaḥ |
arjunāt subhadrāyām abhimanyuḥ ||

naravāhanasyāśvamedhāyāṃ kṣemakaḥ |
kṣemakāntāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ somavaṃśo nivartate ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe somavaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 22 ||

prathamaṃ tāvat svāyaṃbhuvaṃ manvantaraṃ tatsvarūpaṃ kathitam |
sargādau svārociṣo nāma dvitīyo manuḥ ||

tasmin svārociṣe manvantare vipaścin nāma devendraḥ |
pārāvatāḥ satuṣitā devāḥ ||
ūrjastambaḥ suprāṇo danto nirṛṣabho varīyān īśvaraḥ somaḥ saptarṣayaś caivaṃ kiṃpuruṣādyāḥ svārociṣasya manoḥ putrā rājāno bhavanti ||
ḥsudhāmānaḥ satyāḥ śivāḥ pratardanā vaṃśavartinaś ca devāḥ |

vandyāḥ saptarṣayo 'bhavan |
atra paraśucitrādyā manoḥ sutāḥ ||

caturthas tāmaso nāma manuḥ |
tatra manvantare surāḥ parāḥ satyā sudhiyaś ca saptaviṃśatikā gaṇāḥ ||

tatra bhṛśuṇḍī nāma devendraḥ |
hiraṇyaromā devaśrīr ūrdhvabāhur devabāhuḥ sudhāmā ha parjanyo munir ity ete saptarṣayaḥ ||
jyotirdhāmā pṛthuḥ kāśyo 'gnir dhanaka ity ete tāmasasya manoḥ putrā rājānaḥ ||
ḥtasyāntare 'mitā niratā vaikuṇṭhāḥ sumedhasa ity ete devagaṇāś caturdaśakā gaṇāḥ |
ḥsaptakādyā manoḥ sutā rājāno vai babhūvuḥ ||
śāntaḥ śāntabhayo vidvāṃs tapasvī medhāvī sutapāḥ saptarṣayo 'bhavan ||
ḥsuśāntā āpyāḥ prasūtā bhavyāḥ prathitāś ca mahānubhāvāḥ lekhādyāḥ pañcaite hy aṣṭakā gaṇās tatra devāḥ ||

teṣām indro manojavaḥ |
medhāḥ sumedhā virajā haviṣmān uttamo matimān nāmnā sahiṣṇuś caite saptarṣayaḥ ||

saptamo vaivasvato manuḥ sāṃprataṃ vartate |
tasya putrā ikṣvākuprabhṛtayaḥ kṣatriyā bhūbhujaḥ ||
vaśiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo 'trir jamadagnir gautamaviśvāmitrabharadvājāḥ saptarṣayo bhavanti ||
ḥtad yathā ādityāt saṃjñāyāṃ jāto yo manuḥ pūrvoktaś chāyāyām utpanno manur dvitīyaḥ sa tu |
ḥpūrvajasya sāvarṇasya manvantaraṃ sāvarṇikam aṣṭamaṃ śṛṇu ||
manuḥ sāvarṇo aṣṭamo bhavitā tatra sutapādyā devagaṇās teṣāṃ balir indro bhavitā ||

dīptimān gālavo nāma kṛpadrauṇivyāsarṣyaśṛṅgāś ca saptarṣayo bhavitāraḥ |
virājorvarīyanirmokādyāḥ sāvarṇasya manoḥ sutā rājāno bhaviṣyanti ||

navamo dakṣasāvarṇir manur bhavitā |
dhṛtiḥ kīrtir dīptiḥ ketuḥ pañcahasto nirāmayaḥ pṛthuśravādyā dakṣasāvarṇā rājāno 'sya manoḥ putrāḥ ||

marīcigarbhāḥ sudharmāṇo haviṣmantas tatra devatāḥ |
teṣāṃ indro 'dbhutaḥ ||
savanaḥ kṛtimān havyo vasumedhātithir jyotiṣmān ity ete saptarṣayaḥ ||
ḥhaviṣmān sukṛtiḥ satyas tapomūrtir nābhāgaḥ pratimokaḥ saptaketur ity ete saptarṣayaḥ ||
sukṣetra uttamo bhūriṣeṇādayo brahmasāvarṇiputrā rājāno bhaviṣyanti ||

nirmohas tattvadarśī nikaṃpo nirutsāho dhṛtimān rucya ity ete saptarṣayaḥ |
citrasenavicitrādyā dharmasāvarṇiputrā bhūbhṛto bhaviṣyanti ||
kṛtadhāmā tatrendro haritā rohitāḥ sumanasaḥ sukarmāṇaḥ sutapāś ca devāḥ ||
tapasvī cārutapās tapomūrtis taporatis tapodhṛtir jyotis tapa ity ete saptarṣayaḥ ||
devavān devaśreṣṭhādyās tasya manoḥ sutā bhūpālā bhaviṣyanti ||

niścito 'gnitejā vapuṣmān dhṛṣṭo vāruṇir haviṣmān nahuṣo bhavya iti saptarṣayaḥ |
sudharmā devānīkādayas tasya manoḥ putrāḥ pṛthvīśvarā bhaviṣyanti ||

agnibāhuśuciśukramādhavaśivābhīmajitaśvāsā ity ete saptarṣayaḥ |
urugaṃbhīrabrahmādyās tasya manoḥ sutāḥ rājanaḥ ||

evaṃ te caturdaśa manvantarāṇi kathitāni |
rājānaś ca yair iyaṃ vasudhā pālyate ||
putrāś ca bhūpā munayaś ca sarve
ity evam ukto muninā sa rājā

sa tu siddhe pitari maharṣibhir abhiṣikto dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ pālayan vimānastham anantabhogaśāyinam acyutam ārādhya yāgair api devān iṣṭvā svaputraṃ rājye subāhum abhiṣicya divam āruroha |
subāhor bhrājamānād udyoto 'bhigīyate |
sa tu saptadvīpāṃ pṛthvīṃ dharmeṇa pālayitvā bhaktiṃ parāṃ nārāyaṇe pitāmahavat kṛtvā kratubhir bhūridakṣiṇair yajñeśvaraṃ niṣkāmena manaseṣṭvā nityaṃ nirañjanaṃ nirvikalpaṃ paraṃ jyotir amṛtākṣaraṃ paramātmarūpaṃ dhyātvā harim anantaṃ ca param ārādhya svargalokaṃ gataḥ ||
tasya yuvanāśvo yuvanāśvasya ca māndhātā putro 'bhavat |
sa cābhiṣikto maharṣibhir nisargād eva viṣṇubhakto 'nantaśayanam acyutaṃ bhaktyārādhayan yāgaiś ca vividhair iṣṭvā saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthivīṃ paripālya divaṃ gataḥ ||
tasya purukuśyo 'bhavad yena devā brāhmaṇāś ca yāgadānaiḥ saṃtuṣṭāḥ ||

purukuśyād dṛṣado dṛṣadād abhiśaṃbhuḥ |
abhiśaṃbhor dāruṇo dāruṇāt sagaraḥ ||

sagarād dharyaśvo haryaśvād dhārīto hārītād rohitāśvaḥ |
rohitāśvād aṃśumān ||
ḥyena mahatā tapasā purā divo gaṅgā aśeṣakalmaṣanāśinī caturvidhapuruṣārthadāyinī bhuvam ānītā |
ḥasthiśarkarābhūtāḥ kapilamaharṣinirdagdhāś ca guravaḥ sagarākhyā gaṅgātoyasaṃspṛṣṭā divam āropitāḥ |

dīrghabāhor ajo 'jād daśarathaḥ |
tasya gṛhe rāvaṇavināśārthaṃ sākṣān nārāyaṇo 'vatīrṇo rāmaḥ ||
ḥsa tu pitṛvacanād bhrātṛbhāryāsahito daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ prāpya tapaś cacāra |

ḥvane rāvaṇāpahṛtabhāryo bhrātrā saha duḥkhito 'nekakoṭivānaranāyakasugrīvasahāyo mahodadhau setuṃ nibadhya tair gatvā laṅkāṃ rāvaṇaṃ devakaṇṭakaṃ sabāndhavaṃ hatvā sītām ādāya punar ayodhyāṃ prāpya bharatābhiṣikto vibhīṣaṇāya laṅkārājyaṃ vimānaṃ vā dattvā taṃ preṣayām_asa |
ḥsa tu parameśvaro vimānastho vibhīṣaṇena nīyamāno laṅkāyām api rākṣasapuryāṃ vastum anicchan puṇyāraṇyaṃ tatra sthāpitavān ||

tan nirīkṣya tatraiva mahāhibhogaśayane bhagavān śete |
so 'pi vibhīṣaṇas tatas tadvimānaṃ netum asamarthaḥ tadvacanāt svāṃ purīṃ jagāma ||
nārāyaṇasaṃnidhānān mahad vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetram abhavad adyāpi dṛśyate |
ḥrāmāl lavo lavāt padmaḥ padmād ṛtuparṇa ṛṭuparṇād astrapāṇiḥ |
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe sūryavaṃśānucaritaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 26 ||
atha somavaṃśodbhavānāṃ bhūbhujāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa caritam ucyate ||
ādau tāvat samastaṃ trailokyaṃ kukṣau kṛtvā ekārṇave mahāmbhasi nāgabhogaśayane ||
ḥṛṅmayo yajurmayaḥ sāmamayo 'tharvamayo bhagavān nārāyaṇo yoganidrāṃ samārebhe |
ḥsa tu prajāpater dakṣasya trayastriṃśat kanyā rohiṇyādyā bhāryārthaṃ gṛhītvā priyāyāṃ jyeṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣāt prasannamanāḥ rohiṇyāṃ budhaṃ putram utpādayām_asa ||
ḥtasyātiśayarūpānvitasya svargabhogān vihāya urvaśī bahukālaṃ bhāryā babhūva ||

purūravasaḥ urvaśyām āyuḥ putro jajñe |
sa tu rājyaṃ dharmataḥ kṛtvā divam āruroha ||

yasya vaṃśajā vṛṣṇayaḥ |
yayāteḥ śarmiṣṭhāyāṃ pūrur abhavat ||

pūror vaṃśadāyāṃ saṃyātiḥ putro 'bhavat |
yasya pṛthivyāṃ saṃpannāḥ sarve kāmāḥ ||

saṃyāter bhānudattāyāṃ sārvabhaumaḥ |
sa tu sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ dharmeṇa paripālayan narasiṃhaṃ bhagavantam ārādhya yāgadānaiḥ siddhim āpa ||

tasya sārvabhaumasya vaidehyāṃ bhojaḥ |
yasya vaṃśe purā devāsurasaṃgrāme viṣṇucakrahataḥ kālanemiḥ kaṃso bhūtvā vṛṣṇivaṃśajena vāsudevena ghātito nidhanaṃ gataḥ ||
ḥsa tu narasiṃhaṃ bhagavantam ārādhya tatprasādān niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ dharmeṇa kṛtvā divaṃ prāptavān |
ḥduṣyantasya śakuntalāyāṃ bharataḥ sa tu dharmeṇa rājyaṃ kurvan kratubhir bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ sarvadevatāmayaṃ bhagavantam ārādhya nivṛttādhikāro brahmadhyānaparo vaiṣṇave pare jyotiṣi layam avāpa ||

bharatasya ānandāyām ajamīḍhaḥ |
sa ca paramavaiṣṇavo narasiṃham ārādhya jātaputro dharmeṇa kṛtarājyo viṣṇupuram āruroha ||
ḥso 'pi bahuvarṣaṃ dharmeṇa rājyaṃ kurvan duṣṭanigrahaṃ śiṣṭaparipālanaṃ saptadvīpāṃ vaśe cakre |
ḥso 'pi dharmeṇa medinīṃ pālayan pratisaṃvatsaraṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ cakāra |
tasya devadattasyandanārohaṇam aśakyaṃ babhūva purataḥ śakyaṃ ca ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe somavaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 27 ||

śaṃtanayor yojanagandhāyāṃ vicitravīryaḥ |
sa tu hastināpure sthitvā prajāḥ svadharmeṇa pālayan devāṃś ca yāgaiḥ pitṛṃś ca śrāddhaiḥ saṃtarpya saṃjātaputro divam āruroha ||
ḥso 'pi rājyaṃ dharmataḥ kṛtvā muniśāpāc charīraṃ vihāya devalokam avāpa |

sa tu mahatā tapasā śaṃkaraṃ toṣayitvā pāśupatam astram avāpya triviṣṭapādhipateḥ śatrūn nivātakavacān dānavān hatvā khāṇḍavavanam agner yathāruci nivedya tṛptāgnito divyān varān avāpya suyodhanena hṛtarājyo dharmabhīmanakulasahadevadraupadīsahito virāṭanagare 'jñātavāsaṃ caritvā gograhe ca bhīṣmadroṇakṛpaduryodhanakarṇādīn jitvā samastagomaṇḍalaṃ nivartayitvā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha virāṭarājakṛtapūjo vāsudevasahitaḥ kurukṣetre dhārtarāṣṭrair bahubalair yuddhaṃ kurvan bhīṣmadroṇakṛpaśalyakarṇādibhir bhūriparākramaiḥ kṣatriyair nānādeśāgatair anekair api rājaputraiḥ saha duryodhanādīn dhārtarāṣṭrān hatvā svarājyaṃ prāpya dharmeṇa rājyaṃ paripālya bhrātṛbhiḥ saha mudito divam āruroha ||

arjunasya subhadrāyām abhimanyuḥ |
yena bhāratayuddhe cakravyūhaṃ praviśyānekabhūbhujo nidhanaṃ prāpitāḥ ||

abhimanyor uttarāyāṃ parīkṣitaḥ |
so 'py abhiṣikto vanaṃ gacchatā dharmaputreṇa rājyaṃ kṛtvā rājaputro nākaṃ saṃprāpya reme ||

parīkṣitān mātṛvatyāṃ janamejayaḥ |
yena brahmahatyāvāraṇārthaṃ mahābhārataṃ vyāsaśiṣyād vaiśaṃpāyanāt sādyantaṃ śrutam ||

rājyaṃ ca dharmataḥ kṛtvā divam āruroha |
janamejayasya puṣpavatyāṃ śatānīkaḥ ||

sa tu dharmeṇa rājyaṃ kurvan saṃsāraduḥkhād viraktaḥ śaunakopadeśena kriyāyogena sakalalokanāthaṃ viṣṇum ārādhya niṣkāmo vaiṣṇavaṃ padam avāpa |
tasya śatānīkasya phalavatyāṃ sahasrānīkaḥ ||

sa tu bāla evābhiṣikto narasiṃhe 'tyantaṃ bhaktimān abhavat |
tasya caritam upariṣṭād bhaviṣyati ||

sahasrānīkasya mṛgavantyām udayanaḥ |
so 'pi rājyaṃ kṛtvā dharmato nārāyaṇam ārādhya tatpuram avāpa ||
ḥsa tu yathānyāyaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā divam avāpa |
sa ca rājyasthaḥ prajāḥ paripālya mlecchābhibhūte jagati jñānabalāt kalāpagrāmam āśritaḥ ||
vā harau ca bhaktiṃ caritaṃ mahībhṛtām
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe śaṃtanusaṃtativarṇanaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 29 ||
ḥlavaṇekṣurasasurāsarpirdadhidugdhasvacchodakasaṃjñaiḥ parasparaṃ dviguṇaiḥ saptasamudrair valayākārais te dvīpāḥ paridhiṣṭhitāḥ ||

yo 'sau manuputraḥ priyavrato nāma sa saptadvīpādhipatir babhūva |
tasya agnīdhrādayo daśa putrā babhūvuḥ ||
ḥtatra jambudvīpādhipater agnīdhrasya nava putrāḥ jātāḥ ||
ḥnavavarṣāḥ vibhajya putrebhyaḥ pitrā dattā vanaṃ praviśatā |
ṛṣabhād bharato bharatena cirakālaṃ dharmeṇa pālitatvād idaṃ bhārataṃ varṣam abhūt |
ḥilāvṛtasya madhye meruḥ suvarṇamayaś caturaśītisahasrāṇi yojanāni tasyocchrāyaḥ |

tanmadhye brahmaṇaḥ purī |
aindryām indrasya cāmarāvatī |
āgneyyām agnes tejovatī |
yāmyāṃ yamasya saṃyamanī |
nairṛtyāṃ nirṛter bhayaṃkarī |
vāruṇyāṃ varuṇasya viśvāvatī |
kiṃpuruṣādīny aṣṭavarṣāṇi puṇyavatāṃ bhogasthānāni sākṣād bhāratavarṣam ekaṃ karmabhūmiś cāturvarṇyayutam ||
ye pāpakāriṇas tān viddhi pātālatale narake koṭisamanvitān ||
ḥmahendro malayaḥ śuktimān ṛṣyamūkaḥ sahyaparvato vindhyaḥ pāriyātraḥ |

narmadā surasā ṛṣikulyā bhīmarathī kṛṣṇāveṇī candrabhāgā tāmraparṇī ity etāḥ sapta nadyaḥ |
gaṅgā yamunā godāvarī tuṅgabhadrā kāverī sarayūr ity etā mahānadyaḥ papaghnyaḥ ||
ḥniṣkāmā ye svadharmeṇa narasiṃhaṃ yajanti te tatra nivasanti |

asyopari antarikṣalokaḥ |
khecarāṇāṃ ramyas tadūrdhvaṃ svargalokaḥ ||
divyākṛtiṃ sapadi tena tataḥ sa eva
rājñaḥ śiśur na ca viveda śarīravārtām
varaṃ varaṃ vatsa vṛṇīṣva yas te
sve cintyamānaṃ tv idam eva mūrtaṃ
kiṃ vā karomīti sasaṃbhramaḥ sa tu
vimalitam iva cittaṃ pūrṇam eva dhruvasya

akhilamunijananivahanamitacaraṇaḥ |
kharakadanakaraḥ |
capalacaritaḥ |
devārādhitapādajalaḥ |
sajalajaladharaśyāmaḥ |
śamitasaubhapatiśālvādhāmā |
abhirāmarāmātivinayakṛtanavarasarasāpahatendriyasuraramaṇīvihitāntaḥkaraṇānandaḥ |
anādinidhanaḥ |
adhananijadvijamitroddharaṇadhīraḥ |
avadhīritasuranāthanāthitavipakṣapakṣaḥ |
ṛkṣarājabilapraveśāpahatasyamantakāpamārjita nijāpavādadūritahṛtatrailokyabhāraḥ |
dvārakāvāsanirataḥ |
svaritamadhuraveṇuvādanaśravaṇāmṛtaprakaṭita atīndriyajñānaḥ |
yamunātaṭacaraḥ |
dvijadhenubhṛṅgagaṇais tyaktanijanijāhāraḥ |
saṃsāradustarapārāvārasamuttāraṇāṅghripotaḥ |
svapratāpānalahutakālayavanaḥ |
vanamālādharavaramaṇikuṇḍalālaṃkṛtaśravaṇaḥ |
nānāprasiddhābhidhānaḥ |
nigamavibudhamunijanavacanamanogocaraḥ |
kanakapiśaṅgakauśeyavāso bhagavān bhṛgupadakaustubhavibhūṣitoraḥsthalaḥ |
svadayitākrūranijajananīgokulapālakacatur bhujaśaṅkhacakragadāpadmatulasīnavadala dāmahārakeyūrakaṭakamukuṭālaṃkṛtaḥ |
sunandanādibhāgavatopāsitaviśvarūpaḥ |
purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
uttamaślokaḥ |
lokāvāso vāsudevaḥ |
śrīdevakījaṭharasaṃbhūtaḥ |
bhūtapativirañcinatacaraṇāravindaḥ |
vṛndāvanakṛtakeligopikājanaśramāpahaḥ |
satataṃ saṃpāditasujanakāmaḥ |
kundanibhaśaṅkhadharam indunibhavaktraṃ sundarasudarśanam udāratarahāsaṃ vidvajjanavanditam idaṃ ye rūpam atihṛdyam akhileśvaraṃ nato 'smi |
dṛṣṭvā dṛḍhaṃ nātha na hi tyajāmi
kāmān na yāce sa hi ko 'pi mūḍho
ato na yāce varam īśa yuṣmat
punaḥ punas tvām idam eva yāce
sthānaṃ paraṃ prāpnuhi yan mataṃ te
mama prasādāt tava sā ca mātā
hareḥ prasādān na ca citram etat
|| iti śrīnarasimhapurāṇe sahasrānīkacarite mārkaṇḍeyenopadiṣṭasaṃmārjanopalepaphalaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 33 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe sahasrānīkacarite śrīviṣṇoḥ pūjāvidhir nāma catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 34 ||
gavāṃ ca bhṛtyaiḥ saha bhūpateś ca
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe lakṣahomavidhir nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 35 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe hareḥ prādurbhāvānukramaṇe ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 36 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapūrāṇe matsyaprādurbhāvo nāma saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 37 ||
kathām imāṃ yaś ca śṛṇoti mānavaḥ
vihāya pāpaṃ ca naro hariṃ vrajet
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe vārāhaprādurbhāvo nāma ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 39 ||
na dine na ca naktaṃ me
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe viṣṇor nāmastotraṃ nāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 40 ||
prasāda ity eṣa vadan sa vipro
kiṃ vā na kuryur bharaṇāya lubdhāḥ
bhavaty abhūc citram aje ca bhaktiḥ
alaṃ na te harivapuṣaṃ tu kevalaṃ
na vadhya ity adya kṛpā mamābhūt
bhavasi sadā ca vadāṅga yady aguhyam
bhavavibhavaḥ kila bhāti yas tam enam
drutam atha vā parivarjya eva dūrāt
dvaṃdvaṃ na vastrair na dhanaiḥ śramair na
yady apy etair na te kṛtyaṃ
dhīrāḥ sadaiva sa kathaṃ mama gocaraḥ syāt
andhaṃ mano me kva hariḥ kva vāham
tan me tāvad uro nṛsiṃhakarajair vyādīryate sāṃprataṃ
daive durjanatāṃ gate tṛṇam api prāyo 'py avajñāyate
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe narasiṃhaprādurbhāvo nāma catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 44 ||
muniḥ sa dhenuṃ ca dudoha dogdhrīm
yas tv etāṃ hartum icched vai
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe paraśurāmaprādurbhāvo nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 46 ||
rāma rāma mahābāho tāṭakā nāma rākṣasī
tayā manuṣyā bahavo muniputrā mṛgās tathā
aho bhavān kena hatas tvam īdṛśīṃ
vadāmi dṛṣṭaṃ ca kṛtaṃ ca sadyaḥ
jahy adya duṣṭaṃ sagaṇaṃ tu nairṛtam
yat kṛtaṃ tan na kartuṃ ca
śrutvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca ruroda rāmaḥ

tadā lakṣmaṇaḥ rāmasya karṇe lagitvā pitṛvadhavairasmaraṇe atha tadbaktivīryaparīkṣaṇāya lakṣaṇavijñānāyādiśyatām aṅgadāya dūtyam |
rāmaḥ sādhu iti bhaṇitvā aṅgadaṃ sabahumānam avalokya ādiśati ||
pitā te yad vālī balini daśakaṇṭhe kalitavān
na śaktās tad vaktuṃ vayam api mudā tena pulakaḥ
sa eva tvaṃ vyāvartayasi tanujatvena pitṛtāṃ

aṅgado maulimaṇḍalamilatkarayugalena praṇamya yad ājñāpayati devaḥ |
avadhāryatām ||
kiṃ vā sainyam ahaṃ drutaṃ raghupate tatraiva saṃpādaye
atyalpaṃ kulaparvatair aviralair badhnāmi vā sāgaraṃ
devādeśaya kiṃ karomi sakalaṃ dordaṇḍasādhyaṃ mama
śrīrāmas tadvacanamātreṇaiva tadbhaktiṃ sāmarthyaṃ cāvekṣya vadati ||
sīteyaṃ pravimucyatām iti vaco gatvā daśāsyaṃ vada
nyasto girir yena dhṛtaḥ purā mahān
yamaṃ ca jitvā gurave sutaṃ dadau
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe kṛṣṇaprādurbhāve nāma tripañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 53 ||
śṛṇoti nityaṃ sa tu yāti viṣṇum
sarvaḥ sarvaṃ ca jānāti vṛddhān anupasevya ca
|| ity śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe śukravarapradāno nāma pañcapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 55 ||
tadā hy asau yāti hareḥ padaṃ tu
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe pratiṣṭhāvidhir nāma ṣaṭpañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 56 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe brāhmaṇadharmakathanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 57 ||
phalaṃ hi tasyāḥ sakalaṃ hi vindati
evaṃ hi viprāḥ kathito mayā vaḥ
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe vānaprasthadharmo nāma ekonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 59 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe yatidharmo nāma ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 60 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe viṣṇor arcāvidhir nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 62 ||
prāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo yat kāṅkṣanti mumukṣavaḥ
svargasya rājyaṃ na ca kiṃcid eva
bhogasya cānte na ca kiṃcid asti
kartuṃ samarthā na ca kiṃcid eva
sā tvaṃ samāgaccha bhajasva māṃ cirān
uktā ca saivaṃ madhuraṃ ca tena
jagāda bhūyo na ca kiṃcid eva
viśāmi cāgniṃ na ca veda kaścit
hṛtā ca kenāpi vayaṃ na vidmo
dhruvaṃ na tasyāsti bhayaṃ ca mṛtyoḥ
na copakārair na guṇair na sauhṛdaiḥ
kāntā te cāsti vā na vā
kathām imāṃ yas tu śṛṇoti mānavaḥ
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe sahasrānīkacarite 'ṣṭākṣaramantrakathanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 63 ||
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva bhrātṛn atha pitāmahān
imaṃ stavaṃ yaḥ paṭhate sa mānavaḥ
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe ādye dharmārthamokṣadāyini viṣṇuvallabhe pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 65 ||
snānāc ca tatra manujā na punar bhavanti
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe mānasatīrthavrataṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || NarP 67 ||
|| iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe sūtabharadvājādisaṃvāde sarvaduḥkhopaharaṃ śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇasya māhātmyaṃ samāptam || NarP 68 ||
